     3	Dead `.presence/<id>.json` files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` — deletion happened only in `unregister()` (clean exit), so crash/`kill -9` garbage accumulated forever. Header-only session files lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.
     4	
     5	### Fix
     6	
     7	- `file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeats — deletes a stale file when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe) or its age passes a 5-min `cleanupAfter` grace (mtime fallback for torn files); fresh files and live pids are never deleted.
     8	- `pid_probe_io.dart` (new, via `lib/io.dart`): `probePidAlive` — the POSIX `kill -0` probe; wired into both store sites in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`. No probe (Windows) degrades to the time grace.
     9	- `session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({olderThan})` mtime age guard — a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
    10	- `session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-min grace, best-effort).
    11	
    12	### Test Coverage
    13	
    14	- `attach_test.dart`: stale-past-grace deleted; stale-but-young kept; live pid kept past the grace; dead pid removed without the grace; torn file ages by mtime.
    15	- `session_repo_test.dart`: `olderThan` keeps fresh header-only + real sessions, trashes old header-only ones.
    16	- `header_only_session_sweep_test.dart`: dead-wiring guard — the real CLI boot sweeps an old header-only session, keeps fresh/real ones.
    17	- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: 11549 passed, 0 failed.
    18	
    19	### Notes
    20	
    21	- Sweeps only delete inside the `.presence` dir being listed; failures are retried by the next reader (the app's 3 s poll keeps sweeping with no CLI running).
    22	- Windows (no pid probe): a CLI suspended > 5 min can lose its row to another reader; self-heals on CLI restart. `office_addin/` analyzer noise is pre-existing and unrelated.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` heartbeat files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` (15 s staleness window) — the only deletion path was `unregister()`, which runs on clean exit, so `kill -9`/crash garbage accumulated without bound. Header-only session files (one `{type:session}` line, no transcript) from crashed runs lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/attach/file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeat files. A stale entry is deleted when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe, no grace needed) or — without a pid/probe — its heartbeat age passes a 5-minute `cleanupAfter` grace (file mtime as fallback age for torn files). Fresh files and live pids (suspended process that may resume) are never deleted.
- `lib/src/session/attach/pid_probe_io.dart` (new, exported from `lib/io.dart`): `probePidAlive(pid)` — the POSIX `kill -0` probe; `null` ("no probe on this host") degrades to the time-based grace. Wired into both `FileSessionPresenceStore` sites in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`.
- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({Duration? olderThan})` — new mtime age guard so a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot (`_initializeSession`) fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-minute grace, best-effort, never delays the first turn).
- Docs: updated the `SessionPresenceStore` contract comment and the AGENTS.md attach section.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/attach/attach_test.dart` — 5 new tests: stale file past the grace deleted from disk; stale-but-young file kept within the grace; live pid keeps its file past the grace (probe consulted); provably dead pid's file removed without the grace; torn (unparseable) file ages by mtime.
- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart` — `cleanupEmptySessions(olderThan:)` removes an old header-only file and keeps a fresh header-only file plus an old session with transcript.
- `test/cli/header_only_session_sweep_test.dart` — dead-wiring guard: the real CLI boot trashes an old header-only session and keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — all green (results in the run log); `dart analyze` clean on all touched paths.

### Notes

- Deletion happens only inside the `.presence` directory being listed; failures are swallowed and retried by the next reader (app polls every 3 s, so sweeps continue even with no CLI running).
- On hosts without a pid probe (Windows) cleanup falls back to the 5-minute grace. A CLI suspended longer than the grace can have its file swept by another reader; its heartbeat touch then no-ops until the process restarts (bounded, self-healing — documented in the store's docs).
- Pre-existing `dart analyze` issues in `office_addin/` (missing `package:fa_office_agent` in this environment) are unrelated to this change.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` — deletion happened only in `unregister()` (clean exit), so crash/`kill -9` garbage accumulated forever. Header-only session files lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeats — deletes a stale file when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe, `probePidAlive` in new `pid_probe_io.dart` via `lib/io.dart`, wired in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) or its age passes a 5-min `cleanupAfter` grace (mtime fallback for torn files); fresh files and live pids are never deleted. No probe (Windows) degrades to the time grace.
- `session_repo.dart` + `session_commands.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({olderThan})` gains an mtime age guard, and every CLI boot fires it fire-and-forget (10-min grace, best-effort) — a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.

### Test Coverage

- `attach_test.dart`: stale-past-grace deleted; stale-but-young kept; live pid kept past the grace; dead pid removed without the grace; torn file ages by mtime.
- `session_repo_test.dart` + `header_only_session_sweep_test.dart`: the `olderThan` guard, and a dead-wiring guard — the real CLI boot sweeps an old header-only session, keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: 11549 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- Sweeps only delete inside the `.presence` dir being listed; failures are retried by the next reader (the app's 3 s poll keeps sweeping with no CLI running). Windows (no pid probe): a CLI suspended > 5 min can lose its row to another reader; self-heals on CLI restart. `office_addin/` analyzer noise is pre-existing and unrelated.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` heartbeat files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` (15 s staleness window) — the only deletion path was `unregister()`, which runs on clean exit, so `kill -9`/crash garbage accumulated without bound. Header-only session files (one `{type:session}` line, no transcript) from crashed runs lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/attach/file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeat files. A stale entry is deleted when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe, no grace needed) or — without a pid/probe — its heartbeat age passes a 5-minute `cleanupAfter` grace (file mtime as fallback age for torn files). Fresh files and live pids (suspended process that may resume) are never deleted.
- `lib/src/session/attach/pid_probe_io.dart` (new, exported from `lib/io.dart`): `probePidAlive(pid)` — the POSIX `kill -0` probe; `null` ("no probe on this host") degrades to the time-based grace. Wired into both `FileSessionPresenceStore` sites in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`.
- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({Duration? olderThan})` — new mtime age guard so a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot (`_initializeSession`) fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-minute grace, best-effort, never delays the first turn).
- Docs: updated the `SessionPresenceStore` contract comment and the AGENTS.md attach section.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/attach/attach_test.dart` — 5 new tests: stale file past the grace deleted from disk; stale-but-young file kept within the grace; live pid keeps its file past the grace (probe consulted); provably dead pid's file removed without the grace; torn (unparseable) file ages by mtime.
- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart` — `cleanupEmptySessions(olderThan:)` removes an old header-only file and keeps a fresh header-only file plus an old session with transcript.
- `test/cli/header_only_session_sweep_test.dart` — dead-wiring guard: the real CLI boot trashes an old header-only session and keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — all green (results in the run log); `dart analyze` clean on all touched paths.

### Notes

- Deletion happens only inside the `.presence` directory being listed; failures are swallowed and retried by the next reader (app polls every 3 s, so sweeps continue even with no CLI running).
- On hosts without a pid probe (Windows) cleanup falls back to the 5-minute grace. A CLI suspended longer than the grace can have its file swept by another reader; its heartbeat touch then no-ops until the process restarts (bounded, self-healing — documented in the store's docs).
- Pre-existing `dart analyze` issues in `office_addin/` (missing `package:fa_office_agent` in this environment) are unrelated to this change.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` — deletion happened only in `unregister()` (clean exit), so crash/`kill -9` garbage accumulated forever. Header-only session files lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeats — deletes a stale file when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe) or its age passes a 5-min `cleanupAfter` grace (mtime fallback for torn files); fresh files and live pids are never deleted.
- `pid_probe_io.dart` (new, via `lib/io.dart`): `probePidAlive` — the POSIX `kill -0` probe; wired into both store sites in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`. No probe (Windows) degrades to the time grace.
- `session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({olderThan})` mtime age guard — a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
- `session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-min grace, best-effort).

### Test Coverage

- `attach_test.dart`: stale-past-grace deleted; stale-but-young kept; live pid kept past the grace; dead pid removed without the grace; torn file ages by mtime.
- `session_repo_test.dart`: `olderThan` keeps fresh header-only + real sessions, trashes old header-only ones.
- `header_only_session_sweep_test.dart`: dead-wiring guard — the real CLI boot sweeps an old header-only session, keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: 11549 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- Sweeps only delete inside the `.presence` dir being listed; failures are retried by the next reader (the app's 3 s poll keeps sweeping with no CLI running).
- Windows (no pid probe): a CLI suspended > 5 min can lose its row to another reader; self-heals on CLI restart. `office_addin/` analyzer noise is pre-existing and unrelated.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` heartbeat files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` (15 s staleness window) — the only deletion path was `unregister()`, which runs on clean exit, so `kill -9`/crash garbage accumulated without bound. Header-only session files (one `{type:session}` line, no transcript) from crashed runs lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/attach/file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeat files. A stale entry is deleted when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe, no grace needed) or — without a pid/probe — its heartbeat age passes a 5-minute `cleanupAfter` grace (file mtime as fallback age for torn files). Fresh files and live pids (suspended process that may resume) are never deleted.
- `lib/src/session/attach/pid_probe_io.dart` (new, exported from `lib/io.dart`): `probePidAlive(pid)` — the POSIX `kill -0` probe; `null` ("no probe on this host") degrades to the time-based grace. Wired into both `FileSessionPresenceStore` sites in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`.
- `lib/src/session/session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({Duration? olderThan})` — new mtime age guard so a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot (`_initializeSession`) fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-minute grace, best-effort, never delays the first turn).
- Docs: updated the `SessionPresenceStore` contract comment and the AGENTS.md attach section.

### Test Coverage

- `test/session/attach/attach_test.dart` — 5 new tests: stale file past the grace deleted from disk; stale-but-young file kept within the grace; live pid keeps its file past the grace (probe consulted); provably dead pid's file removed without the grace; torn (unparseable) file ages by mtime.
- `test/session/session_repo_test.dart` — `cleanupEmptySessions(olderThan:)` removes an old header-only file and keeps a fresh header-only file plus an old session with transcript.
- `test/cli/header_only_session_sweep_test.dart` — dead-wiring guard: the real CLI boot trashes an old header-only session and keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` — all green (results in the run log); `dart analyze` clean on all touched paths.

### Notes

- Deletion happens only inside the `.presence` directory being listed; failures are swallowed and retried by the next reader (app polls every 3 s, so sweeps continue even with no CLI running).
- On hosts without a pid probe (Windows) cleanup falls back to the 5-minute grace. A CLI suspended longer than the grace can have its file swept by another reader; its heartbeat touch then no-ops until the process restarts (bounded, self-healing — documented in the store's docs).
- Pre-existing `dart analyze` issues in `office_addin/` (missing `package:fa_office_agent` in this environment) are unrelated to this change.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` — deletion happened only in `unregister()` (clean exit), so crash/`kill -9` garbage accumulated forever. Header-only session files lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeats — deletes a stale file when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe) or its age passes a 5-min `cleanupAfter` grace (mtime fallback for torn files); fresh files and live pids are never deleted.

- `session_repo.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({olderThan})` mtime age guard — a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.
- `session_commands.dart`: every CLI boot fires the header-only sweep fire-and-forget (10-min grace, best-effort).

### Test Coverage

- `attach_test.dart`: stale-past-grace deleted; stale-but-young kept; live pid kept past the grace; dead pid removed without the grace; torn file ages by mtime.
- `session_repo_test.dart`: `olderThan` keeps fresh header-only + real sessions, trashes old header-only ones.
- `header_only_session_sweep_test.dart`: dead-wiring guard — the real CLI boot sweeps an old header-only session, keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: 11549 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- Sweeps only delete inside the `.presence` dir being listed; failures are retried by the next reader (the app's 3 s poll keeps sweeping with no CLI running).
- Windows (no pid probe): a CLI suspended > 5 min can lose its row to another reader; self-heals on CLI restart. `office_addin/` analyzer noise is pre-existing and unrelated.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Dead `.presence/<id>.json` heartbeat files were only *filtered* by `FileSessionPresenceStore.list()` (15 s staleness window) — the only deletion path was `unregister()`, which runs on clean exit, so `kill -9`/crash garbage accumulated without bound. Header-only session files (one `{type:session}` line, no transcript) from crashed runs lingered too: `JsonlSessionRepo.cleanupEmptySessions()` existed but had zero production callers, and the clean-exit `deleteSessionIfEmpty` never runs for a killed process.

### Fix

- `lib/src/session/attach/file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeat files. ### Fix

- `file_presence_store.dart`: `list()` now sweeps dead heartbeats — deletes a stale file when its pid is provably dead (new injectable `pidAlive` probe, `probePidAlive` in new `pid_probe_io.dart` via `lib/io.dart`, wired in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) or its age passes a 5-min `cleanupAfter` grace (mtime fallback for torn files); fresh files and live pids are never deleted. No probe (Windows) degrades to the time grace.
- `session_repo.dart` + `session_commands.dart`: `cleanupEmptySessions({olderThan})` gains an mtime age guard, and every CLI boot fires it fire-and-forget (10-min grace, best-effort) — a concurrently booting process's brand-new header-only file is never sweep food.

### Test Coverage

- `attach_test.dart`: stale-past-grace deleted; stale-but-young kept; live pid kept past the grace; dead pid removed without the grace; torn file ages by mtime.
- `session_repo_test.dart` + `header_only_session_sweep_test.dart`: the `olderThan` guard, and a dead-wiring guard — the real CLI boot sweeps an old header-only session, keeps fresh/real ones.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: 11549 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- Sweeps only delete inside the `.presence` dir being listed; failures are retried by the next reader (the app's 3 s poll keeps sweeping with no CLI running). Windows (no pid probe): a CLI suspended > 5 min can lose its row to another reader; self-heals on CLI restart. `office_addin/` analyzer noise is pre-existing and unrelated.
